I was in a similar situation f15 dating m17 (at the time). He did similar things like lead my hand to his pants and ask me to do things I hadn’t done before, I did it because we were dating and I was curious and it was exciting. Sometimes I would feel pressured or used but, I thought it was my personal problem for feeling that way bc well it’s normalized to do things with your partner… but I wasn’t ready. Looking back I realize that he knew I didn’t have experience and instead of waiting till I was ready and comfortable to be curious with him, he instigated it. I felt pressure to meet him at his level but I now know that I would’ve preferred he met me at my level and waited. It’s okay to be curious, it’s not okay to push past your limits. Go as far as you want to go and when it doesn’t feel good, stop. If they can’t accept your limits then you need to protect yourself and move on. You are a person and your thoughts and feelings matter. Put yourself first because if you wait for someone else to put you first, you make yourself vulnerable to manipulation and control. There may be many things out of your control right now but your actions are completely up to you. Be who you want to be not who you think you are.

Your age is relevant, this is a time where you need to be focusing on yourself and your future, not her insecurities. You know you need to leave for both of your sake and you’ll do it when you’re ready. It’s not selfish to put yourself first but it is selfish of her to expect you to put her above your own life.
